lines.speaker: Zidane
lines.text: Well well, looks like the princess wants to be kidnapped!

lines.speaker: Garnet
lines.text: Please, take me away from here. My mother... she's changed.

lines.speaker: Steiner
lines.text: Princess! I cannot allow this! These are common thieves!

lines.speaker: Garnet
lines.text: Steiner, I must go. Something terrible is happening in this kingdom.

lines.speaker: Vivi
lines.text: Those... those things in the factory. They look just like me.

lines.speaker: Vivi
lines.text: Am I... am I just a weapon too? Was I made to hurt people?

lines.speaker: Zidane
lines.text: You're not a weapon, Vivi. You're our friend. That's what matters.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: My home... what have they done to my home?

lines.speaker: Zidane
lines.text: Freya, I'm sorry. We'll make them pay for this.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Kuja... I saw him here. He was watching the destruction like it was entertainment.

lines.speaker: Garland
lines.text: Welcome home, Zidane. You are a Genome — created by me, to serve Terra.

lines.speaker: Garland
lines.text: You were meant to be the Angel of Death. The catalyst for Terra's rebirth.

lines.speaker: Zidane
lines.text: I don't care where I came from. My friends — THEY are my home.
